title: FeedbackRecord
description: One human (or implicit) reaction to a specific reproducible design. Shared by studio and app so both feed the same preference learner.

recipeId.description: DesignRecipe.recipeId this reaction is about — ties feedback to an exact, re-renderable design.

userId.description: Real user id, or 'studio:<reviewer>' for bench feedback that biases global priors.

context.description: Optional scope the design was shown for (helps attribute taste per scope).

weight.description: Optional confidence/strength multiplier for this event (default 1.0).
